description: This file is a shell script intended for testing the functionality of 'git pack-redundant'. It contains test setup procedures, test cases, and execution logic to verify the behavior of 'git pack-redundant' in various scenarios involving Git repositories and packfiles.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates a series of commits in the specified repository with given labels, storing commit SHAs in variables named after each label.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack in the specified repository and assigns its identifier to a variable.

methods.name: format_packfiles
methods.description: Formats and sorts packfile identifiers extracted from the output, normalizing entries for comparison.
